newsitem.title: USA: First Merchants names Plamondon CEO.
newsitem.headline: First Merchants names Plamondon CEO.

text.p: First Merchants Acceptance Corp said Friday it named William Plamondon president and chief executive.
Plamondon was formerly co-CEO of the auto lease financing company, along with Richard Uhl, who was named executive vice president, the company said.
Plamondon and Uhl had been serving as co-chief executives of the auto lease financing company since mid-April in an acting capacity.

"Bill and Rick have been extremely effective in restoring the company's credibility and reputation with our employees, dealer network and the financial community following the dismissal of the former senior management team in April 1997. "These appointments are meant to signal that First Merchants is on the road to recovery and the board wants that progress to continue," the board said in a statement.
Before joining First Merchants, Plamondon had been president and chief executive officer of Budget Rental Corp.
In April, First Merchants, which offers consumers financing for used automobiles, said it had found irregularities in its financial records and fired its president and other executives.
